text: Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there, and just then the redeemer he had spoken of came by. Boaz said, Come over here, friend, and sit down. So he came and sat down.
Then Boaz gathered ten of the elders of the town and said, Sit here. And they sat down.
Boaz said to the redeemer, Naomi, who has returned from the country of Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelech.

I thought I should tell you and say, Buy it in the presence of those sitting here and the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so; but if you will not, tell me, so I will know, for no one has the right to redeem it except you, and after you, me. He said, I will redeem it.
Then Boaz said, On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the dead man's widow, in order to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.
At this the redeemer said, Then I cannot redeem it myself, or I would risk ruining my own inheritance. You redeem it yourself; I cannot.

Now in earlier times in Israel, to confirm any matter of redeeming or transferring property, one party would remove his sandal and give it to the other. This was the manner of confirming a transaction in Israel.
So the redeemer said to Boaz, Buy it yourself. And he removed his sandal.
Then Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, You are witnesses today that I have bought from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech, Chilion, and Mahlon.

I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon's widow, as my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, so that his name will not disappear from among his family or from the gate of his hometown. You are witnesses today.

Then the elders and all the people at the gate said, We are witnesses. May the LORD make this woman, who is coming into your home, like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel. May you prosper in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.
May your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring the LORD will give you through this young woman.
So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. He was intimate with her, the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
The women said to Naomi, Praise the LORD, who has not left you without a redeemer today. May this child's name become well known in Israel.
He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age, for your daughter-in-law who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him.
Naomi took the child, held him to her chest, and cared for him as if he were her own.
The neighbor women gave him a name, saying, A son has been born to Naomi, and they named him Obed. He became the father of Jesse, the father of David.
This, then, is the family line of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron,
Hezron the father of Ram, Ram the father of Amminadab,
Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,
Salmon the father of Boaz, Boaz the father of Obed,
Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David.
